note: Which palaces and concepts a life domain gathers, for the report-wide ledger (src/interpret/reason/ledger.ts). A system convention (he_thong), labelled as such: the usual practice of reading a matter through its own palace, the palace's tam phương tứ chính and the palaces the books tie to it. Where a book sentence ties palaces together it is cited in `cite`. The ledger adjudicates each domain once and only by a book relation between its two sides; without one, both sides are named and the domain is 'chưa phân xử' (audit 2026-10-22: specificity, tier and timing no longer reconcile a conflict); it never sums scores. Roles: core = the palace of the matter; tam_hop / xung = its tam phương tứ chính; support = a palace the convention adds.

verdicts.thuan: the readings point one way and nothing in the core palace limits them
verdicts.co_dieu_kien: one side is the base and a concrete condition stands on it: a limiting element of the core palace, a lone minor star, or a book relation narrowing a strength (timing is never a condition, audit 2026-10-22)
verdicts.tro_ngai: the limiting side is the base; what helps only softens it
verdicts.giam_nhe: a limit a book relation makes lighter: told as a limit with a mitigating factor, never as a strength
verdicts.chua_phan_xu: both sides stand and no book sentence adjudicates them: both are named, nothing is concluded
verdicts.khong_ket_luan: a domain the report never judges good or bad (health): only its book readings are told
verdicts.hai_mat: both sides stand on different facets of the matter (KG facets, not opposites): both are told, each with what it is about
